text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it my all...!
Everything I have right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(If I said I had zero anxiety,
that'd be a lie.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I wondered right up to the end whether I could really
compete against Senior Class veterans. But—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm grand. I put up a fight.
My tsukkomi ain't dead yet...!”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(First, I've confirmed one thing.
Where I currently stand on the road to my revival...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac is so strong...!
Last year's Tiara route was seriously high-level, wasn't it...!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye tends to get all the talk,
but this one's definitely a powerhouse in her own right too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, Lucky Lilac smoothly concluded the first race of her comeback at the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day.
At the meeting to decide our next goal—
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile is a GⅠ race held in the spring at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The battle to determine the strongest miler among Senior Class Tiara Umamusume—
In other words, it is the clash to crown the "Queen" of spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I proposed this race thinking it would be perfect for Lucky Lilac,
who aims to reclaim her title as "Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...I wonder if you have something else in mind.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I agree with running in the Victoria Mile, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Just as you said, Trainer, to become the "Queen" in the Senior class, this is a race we cannot avoid. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Before that, there is a race I'd like to aim for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――"Will you let me run in the Osaka Hai?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit surprised by the suggestion.
...The Osaka Hai is a GⅠ race held at Hanshin Racecourse
to determine the strongest middle-distance runner of the spring.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...In the recent Nakayama Kinen,
I was able to compete against horses on the Classic Triple Crown path
and seasoned veterans in the Senior division alike."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yet when it comes to GⅠ races,
it might be a whole different story.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san has already won completely in the Japan Cup,
even against veterans and those from different racing routes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
To rise again as the "Queen,"
I first want to prove that I have the strength to compete on equal footing...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to make winning
this Osaka Hai my absolute goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, if she can pull off a decisive victory in the Osaka Hai, that glory will be more than enough of a ticket to aim for 'Queen' once more."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Besides, don't you think it's just perfect?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is held at Hanshin Racecourse.
...That's the place where it all started for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where it all began for Lucky Lilac.
Hanshin Racecourse, where she first became "Queen."
In terms of good luck, there's no better place.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The boke and the tsukkomi, standing side by side with fresh resolve.
"Let's start over from Osaka once more~" they'd say—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I think going fully traditional and over-the-top
works just fine too, y'know."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I like that kind of thing too.
Yeah, I like that kind of thing too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"……With that settled, our next target is set on the Osaka Hai.
In that case, the formidable rivals we need to watch out for are――"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks so much
for coming out to Buu's
fan meeting today!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've connected with so many people, and I'm super happy!
Boo's gonna run even more, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck in your next race, Boo-chan!
I'm going to go watch with my friends next time!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"My whole family are big fans of yours!
Next time, every single one of us will come cheer you on!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Boo is brimming with power!!
I'll definitely live up to everyone's cheers--!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to the next Osaka Hai!
My bond with everyone makes me invincible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A GⅠ-tier Umamusume from the Classic Triple Crown route. Debuting in the same year as Lucky Lilac, Blast Onepiece was currently rising rapidly through the ranks.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmhhhh...――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Make them mindful of my run at the Japan Cup and disrupt their pace... Let's start practicing 'Phantom Drive'...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! If this works,
the "Osaka Hai" is gonna be so hyped~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Could her pace have been thrown off...?"
"Impossible! It should be the exact same front-running strategy as the Japan Cup...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And then, a huge two-page spread, BAM!
"I won't be trapped by how I used to run!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! That's a development only I could pull off...!
Let me flesh out the plot with this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —In that Japan Cup, shattering the record alongside Almond Eye with a completely versatile running style: Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Top contenders, led by those two, will surely stand in Lucky Lilac's way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Blast-san, Kiseki-san.
Just what I was hoping for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"She is a worthy opponent.
I shall win, and make everyone understand
that beyond a shadow of a doubt."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Category and generation matter not.
A "Queen" who crushes any strong opponent—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what I'm strivin' to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now, marching forth with pride—
Towards the grand stage to crown the strongest in medium distance.
